decision_question: On 18 new source-anchored book questions, does adding OpenRouter Qwen3 Embedding 4B with equal-weight RRF materially improve exact-anchor hit@5 over the same index’s lexical-only ranking?
comparison: same 884-chunk published index and Tantivy FTS, lexical-only top five versus dense-plus-lexical RRF top five; Qwen vector index already published; no reranker, contextual retrieval, or answer generation
decision_rule: Further explore hosted hybrid for this book only if hybrid gains at least four net top-five hits over lexical-only, has no more than two per-question regressions, all 18 queries complete, and runtime stays within 240 seconds and 8 GiB virtual memory on two low-priority CPU cores. This cannot authorize a global default change.

questions.query: Why is expanding an LLM’s pretraining corpus insufficient for keeping up with private, changing knowledge?
questions.anchor: Increasing the size of training sets is not a viable solution

questions.query: At what point does a RAG system give fetched facts to the language model?
questions.anchor: retrieved information is added to the prompt of an LLM

questions.query: How does ColBERT retain finer document detail than one vector per passage?
questions.anchor: keep vectors for every token and delay the final embedding computation

questions.query: What can undermine an agent when it searches an external repository in place?
questions.anchor: at the mercy of the native retrieval capabilities

questions.query: Why can a PDF parser struggle to recover the document hierarchy?
questions.anchor: designed to render the visual appearance of a document, not its logical structure

questions.query: What happens if a text segment is longer than the embedding model can accept?
questions.anchor: silently truncate the chunks, causing information loss

questions.query: Why do large-scale retrievers narrow results before a more precise stage?
questions.anchor: two distinct phases to optimize both speed and accuracy

questions.query: What should a search input interface help a user communicate clearly?

questions.anchor: in the range of a few seconds end-to-end

questions.query: How can live users help identify unsafe or bad answers after launch?
questions.anchor: allowing end users to report problematic outputs

questions.query: What infrastructure burden does a managed RAG service take over from developers?

questions.anchor: A HubSpot connector might only import part of the customer relationship management

questions.query: Which evaluation mode is used to optimize a pipeline before deployment?
Which facts in a nugget-based check must an answer include to count as complete?
questions.anchor: facts that are considered essential for a comprehensive and correct answer

questions.query: What tooling is suited to extracting text from scans and handwriting?
questions.anchor: scanned documents, images, or handwriting, where powerful OCR is required

questions.query: Why can retrieving a table row without its header lead to a wrong answer?
Why can vector similarity confuse a question about a particular historical date?
questions.anchor: embeddings tend to blur together past and present information

questions.anchor: when the system’s confidence in a match is low
